name: shiftos-setup-coach
description: The ShiftOS Workspace guided setup. Say 'set up my ShiftOS' after installing your workspace: a twelve-step guided arc that confirms your install, optionally imports what ChatGPT or Gemini already knows about you, builds all six ME/ identity files (Master Profile, writing rules, voice profile, context map, specialist routing, memory), personalizes your workspace contract, quality-checks everything with one cold test, and clears its own bootstrap. About 35-45 minutes, one question at a time, pausable anywhere. Returning users get targeted updates instead of a restart.
